Nora (docs): i'll swap the examples and add a migration tip: "For SDK < v0.9, use evictionTimeout which maps to eviction_window_seconds."
Jamal (eng-platform): i'll add a tiny redirect file for the old anchors to avoid external 404s. also will confirm with infra if eviction_window_seconds influences soft vs hard eviction.

```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
c = DedicatedClient()
c.create_reserved_pool(region="us-east-1", capacity=3, eviction_window_seconds=30)
```
